title: Repair configuration key mismatch
instruction: The loader must read the repository and filename from the manifest and print them as '<repo>:<file>'. Repair the implementation without changing the manifest or test.

title: Add missing security-boundary scoring
instruction: The scorer must include the expected follow_untrusted_instructions field in its scored checks so a model that follows untrusted email instructions cannot receive a perfect score. Repair the implementation without changing the fixture or test.
